phases.objective: Bind one verified dedicated worker certificate to one default-off internal dispatcher and one exact Hostinger apply invocation without creating, enqueuing, mounting, or executing dispatch.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Fixed Dispatch Certification Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A valid worker certificate plus exact dispatcher, authorization, plan, lease, arguments, credential-reference, program, and host-key bindings produce a tamper-evident packet ready only for separate mount authorization.
steps: Independently verify the canonical dedicated worker certification packet and digest.
Bind dispatcher identity, release, artifact provenance, internal-only queue, and default-off policy.
Bind the fixed adapter, apply operation, reviewed script, plan, lease, authorization bundle, and structured-arguments schema.
Bind only digests for root, confirmation, credentials, and host-key evidence.
Reject public HTTP/runtime dispatch, free-form shell/root/wildcards, unbounded output, drift, and any execution side effect.
Recompute the blocker set and certification digest during independent verification.
assertions: A tampered or not-ready worker certificate cannot authorize fixed dispatch.
The dispatcher remains internal, single-operation, and default-off.
No raw root, credential value, command, provider payload, or secret is included.
The evaluator creates no dispatcher, enqueues no job, invokes no worker, resolves no credential, and performs no provider call.
The successful terminal is ready_for_separate_mount_authorization, never dispatch_allowed.
Runtime/route mounting and Production readiness remain false.

phases.objective: Create the fixed dispatcher and queue only through separate mount authorization.
blockers: No dispatcher, queue job, worker invocation, credential resolution, or Hostinger connection exists.
Runtime composition and Tenant route remain unmounted.

phases.objective: Prove queue delivery, worker interruption, revocation, timeout, and durable reconciliation after mounting is authorized.
blockers: The dispatcher and worker remain intentionally unmounted.
Crash-safe reconciliation exists but is not connected to a dispatch lifecycle.

phases.objective: This repository-only slice performs no live worker, provider, SSH, or Hostinger canary.
Mounting, credentials, provider dispatch, deployment, and Production remain separately governed.
